author: marioevz
content:
Hey EL devs, I've added Bogota-Devnet-3 discussion to the agenda of next Monday's (Nov 23) ACD-T: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2306

The idea is that you come prepared with arguments of what EIPs should be included or arguments against any EIPs being included. The specs team will prepare their own list of arguments against and for any of the remaining CFI'd EIPs.
We should be extremely careful to consider the new PQ priorities in our rationale.
